comparisonBasis.versionRule: Adobe and Frame.io web documentation is continuously updated. Each source records the page's displayed last-updated date; no marketing claim or undocumented feature is counted.
comparisonBasis.certificationRule: Existence, a UI control, a renderer case, or a shared helper is not certification. CAP-0 records zero certified Editron capabilities.
comparisonBasis.betaRule: An official beta feature may describe the external surface but is marked beta in the source note and never upgrades Editron status.

rowKinds.ATOMIC_FEATURE: A directly invokable editing, compositing, audio, encoding, media-management, review, or security function.
rowKinds.COMPOSITE_WORKFLOW: A user outcome that requires multiple atomic features, durable state, and handoffs.
rowKinds.PRODUCT_DUTY: A reliability, rights, proof, operating, or certification responsibility. It is not an Adobe toolbar command.

editronStatuses.certified: The capability has one canonical owner, deterministic validation, safe mutation, proof, replay/undo semantics, and production evidence.
editronStatuses.live-uncertified: A live path exists, but the complete certification contract is absent.
editronStatuses.partial: Some constituent behavior exists, but semantics, ownership, proof, fidelity, or coverage is incomplete or divergent.
editronStatuses.research-only: Planning, experimental, benchmark, or evidence code exists without a production capability.
editronStatuses.missing: CAP-0 found no implementation that performs the capability.

rows.capability: Project, sequence, bin, and media organization
rows.currentTruth: Projects and a media library exist; Premiere-like bins, sequences, source identity, and durable organization semantics are not established.
rows.requiredDelta: Canonical bins/sequences/media references with durable identity and proof.

rows.capability: Source and program monitoring
rows.currentTruth: Editron previews the timeline but CAP-0 did not find a professional source/record monitor pair.
rows.requiredDelta: Source-range audition, record output monitoring, gang/sync behavior, and frame-accurate proof.

rows.capability: Video/audio tracks, targeting, locking, linking, and channel layout
rows.currentTruth: Overlay ranges are not equivalent to professional track semantics.
rows.requiredDelta: First-class tracks, targeting, locks, sync links, channels, and collision rules.

rows.capability: Insert and overwrite edits
rows.currentTruth: Generic overlay insertion exists; three-point insert/overwrite semantics do not.
rows.requiredDelta: Source/record ranges, targeted tracks, handle validation, and deterministic insert/overwrite mutation.

rows.capability: Lift and extract edits
rows.currentTruth: Delete exists, but lift-versus-extract duration semantics are not represented.
rows.requiredDelta: Distinct gap-preserving and ripple-removing commands with proof.

rows.capability: Frame-accurate regular and rolling trim
rows.currentTruth: Range changes exist through divergent callers; outgoing/incoming trim ownership and frame-accurate two-sided semantics are not certified.
rows.requiredDelta: Canonical regular/rolling trim with handles, sync preservation, conflict checks, and visual proof.

rows.capability: Razor, split, move, delete, and ripple delete
rows.currentTruth: Split/move/delete-like operations exist, but caller semantics and ripple behavior diverge.
rows.requiredDelta: One command vocabulary and one mutation owner with track-aware consequences.

rows.capability: Slip, slide, rate-stretch, and source-range replacement
rows.currentTruth: Speed fields exist in several forms; source-range extraction is a placeholder and slip/slide are absent.
rows.requiredDelta: Canonical source-in/out, duration, retime, slip, and slide operations.

rows.capability: Markers and editorial annotations
rows.currentTruth: No durable frame/timecode marker capability was found.
rows.requiredDelta: Project, sequence, clip, and range markers with author, timebase, comments, and export.

rows.capability: Multicamera source sequences and angle switching
rows.currentTruth: No synchronized angle group or multicam edit model was found.
rows.requiredDelta: Sync by timecode/audio/markers, angle metadata, switching, flattening, and audio-follow rules.

rows.capability: Proxy attachment, toggle, and full-resolution reconnect
rows.currentTruth: Uploaded assets exist without proxy/full-resolution identity and reconnect semantics.
rows.requiredDelta: Source identity, proxy derivatives, matching criteria, relink, toggle, and full-resolution delivery checks.

rows.capability: Offline media relink by filename, path, metadata, and timecode
rows.currentTruth: No professional offline/relink owner was found.
rows.requiredDelta: Stable clip identity, search/match policy, confirmation, and relink audit trail.

rows.capability: Speech transcription with speaker and timecode metadata
rows.currentTruth: Transcription/caption paths exist, with documented length limits and divergent ownership.
rows.requiredDelta: Long-form resumable transcription, stable word timing, speaker identity, correction workflow, and proof.

rows.capability: Text-based rough-cut editing
rows.currentTruth: Semantic planning exists, but transcript edits are not a canonical source-to-timeline command path.
rows.requiredDelta: Transcript selection to explicit source ranges and canonical timeline operations.

rows.capability: Caption tracks, styling, sidecar, embedded, and burn-in export
rows.currentTruth: Captions render, but competing defaults, form owners, track semantics, export modes, and taste certification remain unresolved.
rows.requiredDelta: One caption resolver, track model, legal style catalog, sidecar/embedded/burn-in delivery, and rendered proof.

rows.capability: Titles, graphics, and editable Motion Graphics templates
rows.currentTruth: Text/graphics and generated compositions exist, but template interchange and one form authority do not.
rows.requiredDelta: Certified title primitives, generated composition contract, editable exposed controls, font binding, and template lifecycle.

rows.capability: Effect-property keyframes and interpolation
rows.currentTruth: Transform keyframes exist, but property coverage, interpolation, speed representation, and callers diverge.
rows.requiredDelta: Typed animatable properties, temporal/spatial interpolation, canonical storage, editing UI, and proof.

rows.capability: Vector/object masks and mask tracking
rows.currentTruth: CAP-0 found transforms, not mask geometry, AI object selection, feathering, inversion, persisted mask data, or tracking.
rows.requiredDelta: Mask paths/object mattes, quality modes, matte semantics, tracking evidence, manual correction, offline/relink behavior, and render support.

rows.capability: Motion stabilization
rows.currentTruth: No stabilization operation or renderer contract was found.
rows.requiredDelta: Motion analysis, crop policy, transform solve, failure criteria, and visual proof.
